title: a process step by step (a chain or a cycle)
seam: each stage (the drawn box or picture): data-stage="<key>"; its name: data-label="<key>" inside or right beside it
each arrow from one stage to the next: data-arrow="<from key>><to key>" (and last>first when cycle is true), pointing from the first to the second
a moving token that travels along the arrows: data-token
the active stage: data-active="<key>" on the root element kept current; the next control: data-action="next"
brief: KIND: animated explanation. A process as stages in order (Studio.params.stages), joined by arrows; a cycle when Studio.params.cycle is true (the last stage leads back to the first).

SCENE: the stages laid out in reading order (a row, a zig-zag or a ring for a cycle), each named, arrows between consecutive stages. A token (a drop, a dot, a small creature) travels along the arrow to each stage in turn and the arriving stage glows.
The token starts at the first stage (data-active = first). The next button moves it, with a visible journey along the arrow, to the following stage.

QUESTION: ask (which stage comes after Studio.params.askAfter) with one option button per key in Studio.params.options -> Studio.answer("<key>"); feedback from Studio.onVerdict; options stay tappable after wrong; on correct Studio.done().
antiPatterns: the token jumping to a stage without travelling
stage names placed away from their stage
